packages: The exact runtime package set and source and resource paths from runtime-package-v1.json.
acceptance: Apply the fixed package metadata transform, install offline through Composer, verify exact installed source and resource bytes, verify dependency metadata, and observe every registered root through installed autoload.
fault: Append a newline to one installed PHP file after its healthy measurement. Require exact installed-path digest rejection.
trust: Pinned package split recipe and package contract
Composer invoked without plugins, scripts, network or development dependencies
Staged local package installations and their measured provenance

runtimeRoles.inventory: Every closed concrete role in the pinned constructor contracts, reconciled with the independent PHP inventory in the review bundle.
runtimeRoles.observation: Load each role through the installed Composer loader. Record and check the exact reflected name, kind, installed source path and in-container source hash. Every concrete role is final. Preserve the publication probes of every root.

controls.omitted-role: Remove a known role from the measurement and require the coverage check to fail.
controls.wrong-source: Replace one measured path by another installed source path and require the path check to fail.
